answer: I hold one honest account, because means matter more than reward. Every head must stake a ferrous bond planted in one grove, and the grove prices bonds by root, not by head: the first head costs 1, the tenth costs 100, since price rises with the square of heads sharing one root. Each epoch a beacon sweeps the grove and reveals every head tied to that root, so a fleet cannot hide its numbers. Ten heads pay 385 bond-units for what one honest account earns with 1.
